function.description: Search older original messages in this conversation. History is not new action authority. Use when recent context is insufficient.
function.name: history_search

function.description: Read an original message in this conversation or its explicitly inherited parent excerpt. Other parent, sibling and ancestor messages remain outside scope. Refresh current evidence and acceptance before using historical claims.
function.name: history_read

id.description: Message ID from history_search, search.conversation.hits or the explicit parent excerpt.

function.description: Read a saved tool result using its receiptID. Results are bounded pages. Navigate omitted fields with path; continue with nextOffset. Refresh evidence before citing old results.
function.name: tool_result

offset.description: Field/element offset or Unicode scalar offset for text; initially zero.

items.description: Exact object key or decimal array index. Empty for the root.

rawJSON.description: Read the serialized result as text segments, for unusual keys or exact reconstruction. Use empty path.

function.description: Propose a new structured table from the user's information or retrieved evidence. Up to 40 columns and 100 rows. The user reviews and accepts it before it becomes an active table. Forecasts remain estimates, plans remain plans.
function.name: propose_table

formula.description: Optional deterministic formula referring to column IDs.

items.description: Exact item version ID from retrieved evidence.

meaning.description: actual, estimate, plan, commitment, rule or assumption. Use plan for a new planning table.

items.description: Column IDs mapped to values; decimals are strings. Never invent missing facts.

function.description: List ZIP file members without extracting them. Requires an existing archive source ID.
function.name: archive_members

function.description: Include selected ZIP files only when the user explicitly asks to unpack them. Preserves the original archive and member lineage, with resumable retry. Never automatically recurse into archives.
function.name: include_archive_members

items.description: Exact member path returned by archive_members.

function.description: Search business evidence and older messages in this conversation. Business hits use itemID; conversation.hits use id and require history_read before citation. Business filters/pagination search only business evidence. No match is not proof of absence.
function.name: search

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page, for the same query.

kind.description: Optional domain kind such as document, note, row, movement. Not actual/estimate.

meaning.description: Optional actual, estimate, plan, commitment, rule or assumption.

function.description: Use when the requested answer needs a count of classified Source/Record entries matching metadata filters. This counts entries, not inventory units, facts inside documents or real-world events. It is not needed to verify a balance, validate citations or finish an ordinary answer. Put the receiptID in finish.counts for the exact scoped count.
function.name: count_records

kind.description: Optional exact domain kind, such as movement. Omit to include every kind.

meaning.description: Optional exact meaning; omit to include every meaning.

scenario.description: Optional exact scenario; omit to include every scenario.

status.description: Optional exact status; omit to include every status.

function.description: Read exact evidence and bounded text chunks.
function.name: read

id.description: Exact item version ID returned by search.

function.description: Trace the evidence and derived records around an item.
function.name: lineage

function.description: List workbook tables with IDs, columns and row counts.
function.name: datasets

function.description: Read up to 100 table rows with deterministic formula results.
function.name: rows

datasetID.description: The table ID returned by datasets. Do not use an item/row ID.

function.description: Compare table values deterministically: minimum, maximum, difference and percentage cheaper relative to the maximum. Use for supplier cost comparisons instead of mental arithmetic.
function.name: compare_rows

valueColumn.description: Numeric or calculated column to compare.

function.description: Create a named snapshot of an existing space with exact values and input versions. Limit 1,000 rows per table.
function.name: pin_space

function.description: Propose changed cells for human review. Read rows first, then supply exact row version IDs and only fields to change. Does not alter accepted values until the user accepts the visible proposal.
function.name: propose_table_edit

values.description: Changed column IDs mapped to new values. Decimal values are strings.

function.description: Deterministic decimal arithmetic. Use for arithmetic claims.
function.name: calculate

expression.description: Arithmetic expression, SUM, MIN, MAX, AVERAGE, COUNT, IF or ROUND.

function.description: Calculate accepted actual stock from an opening basis and unique events.
function.name: balance

subject.description: Exact inventory subject, such as brass bolts.

function.description: List saved native spaces.
function.name: spaces

function.description: Save a native space. Every table AND every chart requires its own datasetID. Call this before claiming creation succeeded.
function.name: save_space

aggregation.description: Metric aggregation: SUM, AVERAGE, MIN, MAX or COUNT. Metrics require datasetID and y.

children.description: Required only for comparison; two or three native components side by side. Total tree limit is 16 components.

function.description: Propose a draft interpretation. It does not accept a business event.
function.name: propose_record

items.description: Exact item version ID from retrieved evidence.

kind.description: Domain kind, such as forecast or analysis.

meaning.description: actual, estimate, plan, commitment, assumption or rule.

function.description: Propose a draft inventory movement. The user must accept it before it changes actual stock.
function.name: propose_movement

meaning.description: actual for observed facts; estimate or plan for future scenarios.

occurrence.description: Business occurrence ID; reusing it cannot duplicate its effect.

function.description: Deliver the final answer and declare its basis. Business facts about Sources/Records or earlier messages require basis=evidence and inspected citations, even if a summary or host state suggests the answer. Explain missing/partial evidence and unsuccessful actions.
function.name: finish

answer.description: Plain-language answer. Do not print opaque IDs in prose.

basis.description: evidence: workbook/history facts, requires inspected citations. current_request: only information supplied in this request or arithmetic calculated from it. completed_action: only confirm a successful action in this run. general: guidance, greeting, clarification or verified interface labels; no business or earlier-conversation facts. unresolved: explicitly cannot establish the requested facts; no guessed answer.

items.description: Inspected item version ID, or message:ID returned by history_read for a statement about earlier conversation.

Optional current-run count_records receipt ID, only for entry counts needed by the requested answer. Omit for inventory quantities, calculations and ordinary cited answers. The host renders the exact count and scope. No search or historical receipt IDs.
